armGroups.label: BERLIM 25/20
Empagliflozin + rosuvastatin calcium

conditions: Dyslipidemia Associated With Type II Diabetes Mellitus

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Berlim 25/20 association in the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus and dyslipidemia.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Berlim 25/20 Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus and Dyslipidemia.
identificationModule.officialTitle: National, Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Triple-dummy, Phase III Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Berlim 25/20 Association in the Treatment of Type II Diabetes Mellitus and Dyslipidemia.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Reduction of glycated hemoglobin levels measured between the first visit and the last visit.
Percentual reduction of LDL-c levels measured between the first visit and the last visit.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events recorded during the study.
